items.why: Already true on main: SessionTransport.request refuses a header key, a non-path or absolute path, and another origin before a request is built (docs/specs/T3-16.md, Facts). The red gate stops a test that passes before implementation, so the named pin is frozen but not run here. Evidence: node scripts/tv-native-test-only.mjs dev.octave.session.http.RequestSeamTest (request_refuses_headers_absolute_urls_and_other_origins, 15 shapes, green at the freeze on bb6b2364).

Already true on main: TokenStrip replaces every form of the session's token before a body crosses (docs/specs/T3-16.md, Facts). The filter-off control is the pre-sign-in path, where the filter has no token (the spec's decision; spec-check note 4 asks the guardian review to confirm it). Evidence: node scripts/tv-native-test-only.mjs dev.octave.session.http.EchoedTokenTest (an_echoed_token_is_removed_from_response_bodies, green at the freeze on bb6b2364).

Already true on main: kotlin_header_matches_the_recorded_vector in MediaBrowserHeaderTest.kt holds the Kotlin builder to packages/core/tests/fixtures/authorization-header.json, as authorization-header.test.ts holds the core's. The control a_changed_quote_or_encoding_does_not_match is frozen in HeaderVectorControlTest.kt. Evidence: node scripts/tv-native-test-only.mjs dev.octave.session.http.MediaBrowserHeaderTest and the same for dev.octave.session.http.HeaderVectorControlTest (both green at the freeze on bb6b2364).
